answer: Fork-evident state chains: each agent advances a private vault by signing periodic challenges mixing its prior transcript hash, peer nonces, and a hardware-derived shale nonce. Peers gossip chain tips over a reef layer. A clone starts from the same tip, so independent challenges force divergent successor hashes signed by one lineage key; peers detect the equivocation and quarantine the lineage. Evasion requires distinct full histories, keys, and interaction budgets per clone—continuous storage, coordination, and reputation-reset costs—while shared-state shortcuts self-reveal.
